plainText:
Inuko Inuyama (Japanese: 犬山イヌコ Inuyama Inuko) is a Japanese voice actress for . Her most famous role is that of 's .

==Biography==
Inuyama was born on December 16, 1965, in , . She had previously spelled her name 犬山犬子; her real name is Chie Tozuka (Japanese: 戸塚千絵 Tozuka Chie). As an adult, she became a voice actress and led a prolific career. Out of all the roles Inuyama has held during her career, is the most famous and popular. She has also voiced other Pokémon, a handful of them belonging to a main character, and was the host of the radio program Inuyama Inuko's Pokémon Hour.
